scope: Maintainer-only research navigation; NOT a model input manifest or execution plan.

datasets.name: Ocean dense full fields
datasets.shape: 160 systems x 52 frequencies x 48 depths x 384 ranges x 2 real/imag
datasets.split: 128 train / 32 reused DEV; reserved confirmation is not included
limits: Single source; no source-transfer axis.
Range-invariant ideal ocean, not field measurements.
Same-frequency masks must be defined anew; C needs independently paired model mismatch.

datasets.name: Ocean multistatic
datasets.shape: 512 systems x 9 sources x 4 frequencies x 48 receivers
datasets.split: 256 train / 64 val / 128 used test / 64 used OOD
limits: Three varying environment parameters; not complex real ocean.
Receiver array only, no interior full-field supervision.

datasets.name: Deepwave ring
datasets.shape: 1024 systems x 16 sources x 5 FFT frequencies x 64 receivers; 128/176 variants reuse systems
datasets.split: 512 train / 128 val / 256 used test / 128 used OOD
limits: Finite time-pulse FFT; account for source spectrum/window.
Receiver array, not full interior field.
256 nominal ring receivers alias to 188 unique grid cells; do not duplicate samples.

datasets.name: OpenFWI CurveFault-A
datasets.shape: 1500 systems x 5 sources x 7 FFT frequencies x 70 receivers
limits: Local velocity files are not paired: NEVER use them as model inputs or labels.
Only five source locations; array responses, not interior fields.

datasets.name: Structural lattice
datasets.shape: 1024 systems x 8 sources x 6 angular frequencies x 32 receivers
datasets.split: 512 train / 128 val / 256 used test / 128 used OOD
limits: Angular frequency is not Hz; preserve declared damping/Fourier sign.
Synthetic mass-spring model, not real structural monitoring.

datasets.name: The Well staircase (restricted)
datasets.shape: 16 frequency files; each [26,50,1024,256], analytic-phase repeated time axis
datasets.split: Source/environment identities unresolved; no independent-system split claimed
limits: Do not count 50 phase repeats as independent samples.
No reliable source coordinates; no multi-source or cross-system validation.

datasets.name: WaveBench full
datasets.shape: 50k aligned systems at 10/15/20/40 Hz; complex field and speed labels
datasets.split: Historical subset 8000/500/500 split seed42; test previously used
limits: Previous gain measured speed-contrast identification, NOT phase reconstruction.
No continuous-frequency ground truth or documented arbitrary-source axis.
Do not feed true test medium to the sparse-only model.

datasets.name: Synthetic multi-source complete fields
datasets.shape: 160 systems x 9 sources x 8 frequencies x 64 x 64 complex
limits: Toy model; audit grid convergence for high phase accuracy.
Legacy OOD or higher-grid variants are not automatically new independent confirmations.

datasets.name: Range-dependent one-way waveguide families
datasets.shape: Mixed field/medium/modal/operator archives; see per-subset provenance
datasets.split: Multiple train/DEV/previously frozen confirmation cohorts; all reported confirmations now used
limits: Same one-way PDE across medium families; not independent physics domains.
No backscatter or penetrable seabed; pressure-release top, rigid bottom.
Metadata may contain true medium; enforce public input whitelist.
40 source actions do not mean 40 independent systems.

datasets.name: 2D Helmholtz and public sparse slice
datasets.shape: Gaussian 40 field systems; multiscale 512 medium labels + 8 DEV response systems + 2 audits; sparse 780 complex samples/system
datasets.split: No completed new 64/64 val/test or sparse nonlinear learning result
limits: 512 training media are NOT 512 response demonstrations.
Four-line 6/10/14Hz observations with 11.3/17Hz targets are not route A same-frequency.
Unsafe seed-metadata directory is forbidden for inference.
Full pilot spec contains hidden truth; coarse-grid query error can dominate.

datasets.name: Independent Ocean LF/HF pilot
datasets.shape: 3 environments x 12 frequencies (101-112Hz) x 32 x 128 receivers; independently solved low/high
limits: Not a training benchmark; limited-family far-frequency calibration failed.
8-mode approximation can be ineffective or fail to save computation.
